`class ProgressNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.progress` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ProgressNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/progress/ProgressNode.java)

Shows a progress from 0 to 1 by sizing its fill part over an optional track part.

![A progress bar filled at 60 %](/captures/catalog-nodes-progressnode.webp)

## Description

The fill and the track are nodes of your own: the progress node sizes and places them on every frame.

## Learn more

- [Controls](/use/learn/interactivity/controls/#show-a-progress)
- [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/)
